import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
import time

def create_graph_from_edges(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    return G

def create_partition_problem(graph):
    qubo = QuadraticProgram()
    qubo.binary_var(name=f"node_{node}", index=node)
    qubo.binary_var(name=f"community_{community}", index=community)
    for edge in graph.edges():
        i, j = edge
        qubo.linear_constraint(coefficients=[1, -1], sense='==', rhs=0, variable_name=f"node_{i} + node_{j}")
    for node in graph.nodes():
        qubo.linear_constraint(coefficients=[1], sense='==', rhs=1, variable_name=f"node_{node}")
    return qubo

    qaoa = QAOA(qubo, p_layers=p_layers, reps=1, initial_state=None, insertion_order=None, insert_barriers=False, mixer=None, callback=None)
    return qaoa

def create_sampler(backend):
    sampler = Sampler(backend)
    return sampler

def create_pass_manager(backend):
    pm = PassManager()
    pm.append(PassManager.add_pass(PassManager.initialize_qubits(initial_layout=None), initial_layout=None))
    pm.append(PassManager.add_pass(PassManager.optimize_layout(initial_layout=None), initial_layout=None))
    pm.append(PassManager.add_pass(PassManager.transpile(backend, optimization_level=3)))
    return pm

def run_qaoa(qaoa, sampler, shots=512):
    result = qaoa.run(sampler, shots=shots)
    return result
